title: Grime
tagline: Fast, jagged MC flows over stark electronic beats from UK underground culture.
summary: Grime emerged in early-2000s London from UK garage, jungle, and pirate-radio culture. Its producers built stark, fast electronic instrumentals, while MCs developed agile flows and a distinctly local voice. The scene grew through radio sets, collectives, and independent releases before reaching a wider international audience.

pillars.name: Wiley
pillars.why: Wiley's production and MC work helped establish grime's early sound and vocabulary.

pillars.name: Dizzee Rascal
pillars.why: Dizzee Rascal's early records brought grime's raw energy and intricate flows to a wider audience.

pillars.name: Skepta
pillars.why: Skepta became a leading figure in grime through independent releases, collective work, and international collaborations.
